title: Remapping, namespaces and node arguments
keywords: remap remapping namespace ns ros-args node name relative absolute argument
text: ROS arguments follow --ros-args: -r old:=new remaps a topic or service, -r __ns:=/robot1 sets the namespace, -r __node:=name renames the node, -p name:=value sets a parameter and --params-file loads a YAML file. Relative names (without a leading slash) are resolved inside the node namespace; absolute names such as /scan are not. A subscriber that receives nothing often listens on /robot1/scan while the publisher uses /scan: compare the full names in ros2 topic list.
